item.title: Watch Car and Driver vs. the Bots in a Virtual Lightning Lap
item.description: AI-powered 'Drivatars' compete against C/D's crack team of virtual racers in a 60-lap fight, and we're livestreaming it starting at 1:45 p.m. ET today. Join us!

item.title: 1988 Mazda 323GTX Tested: For the Discerning Pauper
item.description: What to buy if you can't afford an Audi 5000 Quattro.

item.title: The Pathfinder Helped Invent the Modern SUV and Its Latest Evolution Shows Nissan Still Knows the Formula
item.description: With improved performance, smarter tech, and a new transmission underpinned by early go-anywhere DNA, Nissan’s legacy three-row SUV is firmly planted in the present.

item.title: Mazda CX-5 vs. Mazda CX-50: Comparing the Compact-SUV Siblings
item.description: We rate both vehicles highly, but there are differences in terms of size, packaging, and powertrains that you'll want to consider before making a decision.

item.title: Future Mazda Miata Could Reportedly Use Synthetic Fuels or Go Hybrid
item.description: Mazda's next-generation sports car is still a few years away, but the company has yet to make a final decision on its powertrain.

item.title: Report: The BMW X4 M Could Return as an EV Next Year
item.description: The BMW X4 left production last fall, but the chopped-roof SUV is scheduled to return later this year, with an M version to follow.

item.title: 2026 Mazda CX-5: How Does the New CX-5 Compare with the Old One?
item.description: With a stretched body and more interior tech, the new CX-5 promises more space but gives up the optional turbo engine that we liked in the previous model.

item.title: Lincoln Reportedly Developing Bronco-Based Mercedes G-Wagen Rival
item.description: Lincoln's new off-road SUV would arrive at the end of this decade and ride on a body-on-frame platform.

item.title: 2026 Ford Mustang Mach-E's Frunk Has Become an Extra-Cost Option
